summary: test_user_prompt_submit_waits_for_the_turn_write gates the injected client's set_turn and asserts the hook thread is still alive while the write is pending and only returns 0 after release with the ('t1','agent') call recorded, so a fire-and-forget/background write would fail thread.is_alive(); the codex config test pins UserPromptSubmit to `hook agent prompt`, and hook.main runs the same _run_callback path with the injected client (only the SIGALRM deadline is bypassed off the main thread).
